items.title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.

items.title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to discuss this story and what it could represent for Elon Musk's ambitions for SpaceX.

items.title: Tesla Plans Cybercab Launch As Soon As This Month: Report
items.summary: Tesla could begin offering robotaxi rides in Cybercabs by the end of the month, according to The Information. The stock is down 11.5% since last month's earnings call, which showed little progress on robotaxi expansion.

items.title: Swedish Trucking Company Inks Deal For Tesla Semi Truck Rollout
items.summary: On Tuesday, Swedish logistics company Einride bought several hundred Tesla Semi trucks that will be used by Amazon and other customers in North America. Einride stock shot up, before falling about 4%.

items.title: Tesla Is Down 25% in 2026: How Does It Compare to EV Competitors Like Rivian, Lucid, and General Motors?
items.summary: Tesla has shed a quarter of its value this year while one legacy automaker quietly holds its ground in the green. The divergence playing out across the EV sector in 2026 reveals a deeper story about rates, AI spending scrutiny, and which bets investors are quietly abandoning.

items.title: Better Buy: Palantir at 108 Times Forward Earnings or Tesla at 190 Times?
items.summary: They are two of the highest valued large-cap stocks in the market.

items.title: Gary Black Says Tesla Stock Will Remain ‘Moribund’ Until Musk Deploys Unsupervised Cybercabs At Scale
items.summary: Black expressed skepticism on Tesla bulls’ excitement despite little evidence that Cybercabs can operate ‘flawlessly’ without safety monitors.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Could Put 500 Semi Trucks Into Service Through A Freight Deal
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) is partnering with freight technology company Einride to deploy a Tesla Semi fleet that could scale to 500 vehicles for enterprise customers including Amazon. The trucks will run on Einride's Saga AI freight platform, aimed at expanding electric heavy duty logistics use across North America.
